description: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) specialist that enriches file hashes, domains, IP addresses, and threat collections via Google Threat Intelligence (VirusTotal v3) using credentials retrieved at call time from Auth Manager.
name: cti_researcher_agent

skills.description: Queries Google Threat Intelligence (VirusTotal v3) for engine detections, threat classification, and tags on a SHA256, SHA1, or MD5 file hash.
examples: Look up GTI reputation for SHA256 275a021bbfb6489e54d471899f7db9d1663fc695ec2fe2a2c4538aabf651fd0f
skills.name: File hash GTI reputation

skills.description: Queries Google Threat Intelligence (VirusTotal v3) for domain and IP address reputation, categories, ASN owner, and detections.
examples: Check GTI reputation for domain google.com and IP 8.8.8.8
skills.name: Domain and IP GTI reputation

skills.description: Retrieves campaign, threat actor, or malware collection context from Google Threat Intelligence.
examples: Fetch GTI collection details for a threat report ID
skills.name: GTI threat collection lookup

skills.description: Evaluates unstructured threat reports, OSINT prose, PDFs, or screenshots in a single zero-output-token pass to extract actionability, threat category, 1-5 severity, immediate hunt urgency, and 1-5 confidence.
examples: Triage this unstructured OSINT threat report for actionability and hunt urgency
Evaluate this base64 threat advisory PDF or screenshot
skills.name: Unstructured CTI artifact triage
